name: Supabase MCP Server

demo.title: Supabase Remote MCP Server Makes It Easier Than Ever to Build Your Apps With AI

what: Supabase's MCP server that connects AI assistants to your Supabase projects so they can manage tables, fetch config and query data.
who: Vibe coders building apps on Supabase who want the agent to handle the database side.

setup.text: Read Supabase's MCP security best practices first. Connecting an LLM to a database carries real risks.
Add the remote server. Your client will prompt you to log in to Supabase; pick the organization that has your project.
Optionally scope it with URL options. With the local Supabase CLI, the server is at http://localhost:54321/mcp (fewer tools).

install.name: supabase
notes: Connecting an AI to a database carries real risks; read Supabase's MCP security best practices first.

prompts: Create a 'profiles' table linked to auth users with a username column.
List the tables in my project and describe how they relate.
Write and run a query that counts signups per day this week.
